# Reel & Rank — Full Studio Specification

> Reel & Rank is a three-person motion, video and search studio in Houston. Motion graphics, video ads, selling campaigns and SEO, GEO and AEO strategy. Drop an idea and get an initial example in one day.

## 1. Studio Identification & Knowledge Graph
- **Studio Name:** Reel & Rank
- **Entity Type:** ProfessionalService / LocalBusiness
- **Geographic Coordinates:** Latitude 29.7604, Longitude -95.3698
- **Physical Headquarters:** Houston, Texas, USA
- **Founder & Creative Technologist:** Manny Singh
- **Founder Corporate History:** Salesforce, United Airlines, Morgan Stanley, Banco Santander
- **Founder Profiles:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/mannysingh
- **Primary Email:** hello@reelandrank.com
- **Primary Website:** https://reelandrank.com
- **Team Composition:** Dedicated three-person studio (Creative Direction, Motion Design, Editing/Grading)

## 2. Definitional Answer Summary
Reel & Rank is a Houston, Texas motion graphics, video advertising, and search strategy studio offering transparent, flat-rate pricing from $250 to $2,000+. Engagements include three-piece motion graphics sets ($250), 15-second ads ($500), 60-second commercials ($1,000), search optimization (SEO/GEO/AEO from $1,000), and full selling campaigns ($2,000+), each with an initial creative draft in one working day.

## 3. Detailed Offer Catalog & Deliverables

### Motion graphics, set of three ($250)
- **Slug:** motion-graphics-set
- **Tier:** entry
- **Rate:** $250 (set of 3)
- **Starting Price (USD):** $250
- **Turnaround Commitment:** Initial example in one day
- **Best Suited For:** A launch, a product drop, or a message that needs to move.
- **Direct Answer Definition:** The Motion Graphics Set from Houston studio Reel & Rank delivers three synchronized motion graphics assets for a flat rate of $250. Designed for product drops and social campaigns, deliverables include custom aspect ratios, agreed visual hooks, and one refinement round, with an initial draft delivered in one working day.
- **Itemized Deliverables:**

  - Formats and aspect ratios confirmed with the brief
  - One round of refinement inside the agreed direction
- **Contractual Commitments:**
  - We agree the brief, deliverables, formats and timing before production starts.

## 5. Portfolio & Provenance Policy
All featured work on the site represents **RamanRasa**, founder Manny Singh's personal brand.
It is AI-assisted creative produced to showcase aesthetic craftsmanship, pacing, and motion graphics design. It is explicitly presented as portfolio creative rather than paid client testimonials or performance marketing case studies.

## 6. Team Roster & Specializations
### Manny Singh (Founder)
- **Focus:** Story, search strategy and career work
- **Bio:** Founded Reel & Rank. Has worked for Salesforce, United Airlines, Banco Santander and Morgan Stanley, on government contracts and in logistics, and has led technology teams. Leads the search strategy and the 1-on-1 career work.

### Motion and design (Motion and design)
- **Focus:** Motion graphics, titles and visual systems
- **Bio:** Shapes how the work moves: the rhythm of a set, the type that carries a message, and the details that make a frame feel considered.

### Edit and finish (Edit and finish)
- **Focus:** Edit, grade and sound
- **Bio:** Puts the film together. Pacing, colour and sound, and the final pass that makes a cut feel finished rather than merely done.

## 7. Studio Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
### What actually happens in the first day?
You send us the idea. We read it, ask anything that is unclear, and come back within one working day with an initial example you can react to. Full production, delivery dates and the final scope are agreed after we settle the direction together.

### What does "refined until perfect" mean?
For the $500 and $1,000 advertisement offers, we refine the agreed creative direction with your feedback until you are happy with the final result. We agree the brief and the deliverables at the start. If the concept or the scope changes, we discuss that together before it happens.

### What does the search offer guarantee?
We commit to delivering the strategy and the dashboard we agree on. We do not guarantee rankings, traffic, citations in AI answers or sales. Your starting priorities, how progress is measured and the deliverables are agreed on the call before work starts.

### What does the $1,500 career package guarantee?
Manny will keep working with you until you get a job, with ongoing consultations and strategy adjustments at no additional charge. That is the commitment. Hiring decisions stay with employers, so we do not guarantee a job offer or a salary.

### Is the featured work from outside clients?
No. The featured work is RamanRasa, founder Manny Singh's own brand. These are AI-assisted creative concepts, and we present them as founder-owned portfolio work rather than independent client testimonials or performance case studies.

### Can you make something outside these offers?
Yes. Bring the idea. Product ads, brand stories, explainers, social video, TV commercial creative or a custom project are all on the table. Any additional scope and price are agreed before work starts. TV airtime and media buying are separate.

### Where are you, and who will I be talking to?
Houston, Texas. We are a team of three, and you deal with the people making the work. Calls, shareable links and reviews, whichever suits you.
